LanguageData.PV_Settings_UseCustomPaletteOverrides_De: Enable granular RGB/HSV sliders for Radar, Identification, and Scout perimeters. When disabled, curated theme presets apply.
LanguageData.PV_Settings_ThermalIntegrityAudit_Desc: Automatically enforces non-combustible properties on metals, stone, and structural components at startup.
LanguageData.PV_Settings_OptimisticDetours_Desc: Caravans plot paths assuming unmapped fog-of-war sectors are passable, repathing dynamically when impassable terrain is discovered.
LanguageData.PV_Settings_InterFactionCollisions_Desc: Simulates background encounters and skirmishes when rival NPC incursions cross paths on the globe.
LanguageData.PV_Settings_SeamlessZoom_Desc: Allows zooming out past maximum map zoom to open the planetary Geoscape centred on that tile, and zooming in past minimum globe altitude to enter an active battlescape or colony map.
LanguageData.PV_Settings_SeamlessZoomNotches_Desc: Number of extra scroll-wheel notches required after hitting the zoom boundary before transitioning between Battlescape and Geoscape. Higher values prevent accidental transitions.
LanguageData.PV_Settings_SeamlessZoomTarget_Desc: Determines how an active map is chosen when zooming in from the Geoscape when multiple battlescapes or colonies are nearby.
LanguageData.PV_Settings_SeamlessZoomIndicator_Desc: Visual cue shown when scrolling against the zoom boundary to indicate that scrolling again within the window will switch views.
LanguageData.PV_Settings_SeamlessZoomTransition_Desc: Transition effect between Battlescape and Geoscape: Instant (no effect), Fade (brief dark dip), or Traverse (cloud-deck drift). Enabling Reduce Shroud Motion automatically selects Instant.
LanguageData.PV_Diag_ArchDesc: Decoupled RimWorld 1.7 framework suite. Modules operate independently and interconnect automatically when active.
LanguageData.PV_Diag_EmbeddedCoreNote: Running Geoscape with embedded Core fallback. Subscribe to standalone Core Framework to enable optional modules (Orbital, Aquatics, Thermal).
LanguageData.PV_Diag_GovernanceNoSave: No active campaign loaded. Defaults apply to newly started colonies.
LanguageData.PV_Diag_ConfigDesc: Restore all Geoscape defaults or reset new-campaign rules without altering an active save.
LanguageData.PV_Rules_ColonyIdCapTooltip: Capped at {0} hex(es) (Colony scout horizon - 1). Increase Colony scout horizon to unlock higher identification range.
LanguageData.PV_Rules_CaravanIdCapTooltip: Capped at {0} hex(es) (Caravan scout horizon - 1). Increase Caravan scout horizon to unlock higher identification range.
